seedream_generate_image.selection: Pass an exact configured ID as `model`, or omit it for the default. On HTTP, `X-ModelArk-Seedream-Endpoint` can select an exact registered default; explicit tool `model` wins. Custom IDs require an explicit family binding in `SEEDREAM_MODEL_BINDINGS`; arbitrary opaque endpoint lineage is never inferred. Otherwise `SEEDREAM_DEFAULT_MODEL` applies.

models.name: Seedream 5.5
models.capabilities: 10 references; `1K`, `1.5K`, `2K` (default); PNG (default) or JPEG; text-to-transparent PNG; `auto`, `opaque`, `transparent` backgrounds; `standard` optimization only; independent variations, no provider batch.

models.name: Seedream 5.0 Pro
models.capabilities: 10 references; PNG/JPEG; transparent edits require one already-transparent PNG; `standard`/`fast` optimization; independent variations, no provider batch.

models.name: Seedream Lite
models.id: Authorized custom ID; no built-in ID
models.capabilities: 14 references; PNG/JPEG; provider batch supported; no transparent background.

models.name: Seedream 4.x
models.id: Authorized custom ID; no built-in ID
models.capabilities: 14 references; JPEG only; provider batch supported; no transparent background.

seedance_create_task.selection: Pass an exact configured ID as `model`, or omit it for the default. On HTTP, `X-ModelArk-Seedance-Endpoint` can select an exact registered default; explicit tool `model` wins. Custom IDs require an explicit family binding in `SEEDANCE_MODEL_BINDINGS`; arbitrary opaque endpoint lineage is never inferred. Otherwise `SEEDANCE_DEFAULT_MODEL` applies. Limits below are family limits; discovery is authoritative for your server. Regular 2.5 4K is retained server acceptance, not confirmed by current model-specific provider docs; see the [contract caveat](/ark-mcp/models/#video-capabilities-videocapabilities).

models.name: Seedance 2.5
models.capabilities: 480p/720p/1080p/4K on the same model; 4-30 s or auto; 30 images / 10 videos / 10 audios; audio-only references; structured edit/extend; MP4/MOV; Draft final at 1080p, not 4K; Draft window 14 days (7 for creation before 2026-10-28 10:00 UTC+8).

models.name: Seedance 2.5 Flash
models.availability: Added alongside the selected default when bindings are empty; explicit lists must add `seedance_2_5_flash`. Account activation required; discovery does not verify entitlement.
models.capabilities: 480p/720p; 4-30 s or auto; 10 images / 5 videos / 5 audios; audio-only references; structured edit/extend; MP4/MOV; no Draft. Static cost previews reuse the 2.5 fallback, not token pricing.

models.name: Seedance 2.0
models.capabilities: 480p/720p/1080p/4K; 4-15 s or auto; 9 images / 3 videos / 3 audios; audio references require image/video; no Draft or native edit/extend.

models.name: Seedance 2.0 Fast
models.id: Authorized custom ID; no built-in ID
models.capabilities: 480p/720p; 4-15 s or auto; 9 images / 3 videos / 3 audios; audio references require image/video; no Draft or native edit/extend.

models.name: Seedance 2.0 Mini
models.id: Authorized custom ID; no built-in ID
models.capabilities: 480p/720p; 4-15 s or auto; 9 images / 3 videos / 3 audios; audio references require image/video; no Draft or native edit/extend.

seed_audio_generate.selection: This tool has no per-call `model` argument. The Seed Speech adapter uses the fixed model below; this is not a ModelArk model binding.

models.name: Seed Audio 1.0
models.availability: Local `BYTEPLUS_SEED_SPEECH_API_KEY`; HTTP invocation uses `X-Seed-Speech-Api-Key` plus client secret.
models.capabilities: Full-scene speech, music and sound generation; text, audio references or image reference; image and audio references are mutually exclusive; 1-5 independent variations.

seed_understand.selection: Pass an exact configured ID as `model`, or omit it for `SEED_UNDERSTANDING_DEFAULT_MODEL`. Custom IDs require an explicit `turbo` or `pro` binding in `SEED_UNDERSTANDING_MODEL_BINDINGS`.

models.name: Seed 2.1 Turbo
models.capabilities: Images/video; 32 combined media parts; 256K context; deep thinking; text, JSON object or JSON Schema output.

models.name: Seed-series Pro
models.availability: Opt-in default or configured `pro` binding; account activation required.
models.capabilities: Images/video; 32 combined media parts; 256K context; deep thinking; text, JSON object or JSON Schema output.

seed_audio_understand.selection: This tool has no per-call `model` argument. `SEED_AUDIO_UNDERSTANDING_MODEL` selects a ModelArk model supporting Chat Completions `input_audio` with deep thinking; other compatible, authorized IDs may be configured.

models.name: Seed 2.0 Lite (audio understanding)
models.availability: Server-configured model; local `BYTEPLUS_MODELARK_API_KEY` or HTTP `X-ModelArk-Api-Key` plus client secret.
models.capabilities: 1-8 audio clips; transcription, translation, analysis and Q&A; JSON Schema for structured output; oversized URL inputs can use the Files API (up to 512 MB).

omnihuman_create_task.selection: This tool has no per-call `model` argument. The identifier is a Vision AI service `req_key`, configurable with `BYTEPLUS_OMNIHUMAN_REQ_KEY`, not a ModelArk model ID.

models.name: OmniHuman 2.0
models.availability: `BYTEPLUS_OMNIHUMAN_ENABLED=true`; disabled by default. Local `BYTEPLUS_CV_API_KEY` or HTTP `X-OmniHuman-Api-Key` plus client secret.
models.capabilities: Image plus audio to talking-avatar video; asynchronous tasks polled with `omnihuman_get_task`.
